evidence.quote: Long Papers (8 pages) and Short Papers (4 pages)

evidence.quote: Final versions of accepted papers will be given one additional page of content (up to 9 pages for long papers, up to 5 pages for short papers) to address reviewers’ comments.

paper_size.note: 采用 *ACL 官方样式：必须 A4（21cm × 29.7cm）

evidence.quote: All papers must use A4 paper format (21 cm x 29.7 cm).

columns.note: 送审稿须用 *ACL 官方样式的双栏格式

evidence.quote: must follow the EMNLP 2023 two-column format
Left margin: 2.5 cm
Gap between columns: 0.6 cm

body_font_size_pt.note: 正文 11pt；题注/摘要/参考文献 10pt（*ACL 规范）

evidence.quote: document text 11 pt

body_font_family.note: 正文 Times Roman（*ACL 规范）

evidence.quote: should be set in Times Roman

anonymity.note: 送审稿双盲；无匿名期要求

evidence.quote: The reviewing process will continue to be double-blind.

abstract_max_words.note: 摘要不超过 200 词（*ACL 规范）

evidence.quote: It should be no longer than 200 words.

section_numbering.note: 章节用阿拉伯数字编号（*ACL 规范）

evidence.quote: Use numbered sections (Arabic numerals) to facilitate cross references.

page_numbering.note: *ACL 规范：送审版加页码、终稿不加

evidence.quote: Review versions should have page numbers, centered in the bottom margin, but pages should not be numbered in the final version.

bib_style.note: 官方 sty 指定 acl_natbib（author-year）

evidence.quote: \bibliographystyle{acl_natbib}

checklist_required.note: 强制 Responsible NLP research checklist（随 ARR 提交）

evidence.quote: ACL’s Publication Ethics Policy , and ARR’s Ethics Policy including the responsible NLP research checklist

submission_system.note: 经 ARR/OpenReview 投稿并 commit 到 EMNLP

evidence.quote: Both submissions of articles for review and commitment of reviewed articles to the conference will be performed via the Open Review platform

supplementary_policy.value: optional supplementary material; must be anonymized
supplementary_policy.note: 补充材料可选、须匿名，正文不得依赖之

evidence.quote: Submissions may include non-readable supplementary material used in the work and described in the paper.
Captions should be placed below figures/tables, in 10 point roman type.
Captions should be placed below figures/tables, in 10 point roman type.
Captions that are one line are centered. Captions longer than one line are left-aligned.

reference_style_hint.value: author-year in parentheses; alphabetical reference list

evidence.quote: Citations within the text appear in parentheses (Gusfield, 1997)

float_placement_rules.value: near first mention; wide floats may span both columns

evidence.quote: Place figures and tables in the paper near where they are first discussed, rather than at the end, if possible.
grayscale readability is strongly encouraged
